method: Each decision rests on the powers coverage takes coverage-v1332c (candidate 1214cm, the observer's own view from about 9 m) and coverage-v1332d (candidate 1214cn, a close side-on free camera), 12/12 each, under the product controller: every power is granted by name (lab-only coop_grant_named, 1214cm), selected with the native equip and cast with the native left trigger; the partner is checked from its own power presentation state on the observer (power weight above 0.5 for at least three samples, then recovery) and the checkpoint is reloaded after every case. World effects are judged from the reviewed observer videos listed per item. Remote presentation is cosmetic: the partner never casts, spends mana or applies damage (partner exclusion, chapter 34). Lifecycle: every case re-arms the product controller after a checkpoint reload; the 2-hour soak mission-soak-v1316a covers 19 shared restarts and session renewals.

items.scope: Corvo casts and ends Dark Vision (power variant 10) standing armed; the partner presents both gestures and recovers. Dark Vision has no world-visible effect: its reveal and screen effect stay with the caster (first-person scope).

visual.verdict: Corvo raises his left hand to his eye to cast, holds the armed stance, and repeats the gesture to end it; no effect appears in the observer world.

items.scope: Emily casts and ends Dark Vision (power variant 10) standing armed; the partner presents both gestures and recovers. The reveal and screen effect stay with the caster.

visual.verdict: Emily lifts her hand to her face to cast and again to end Dark Vision, sword held low, then settles.

items.scope: Corvo casts Windblast (power variant 11): the partner presents the push and recovery, and the native wind streak plays once in the observer world at the cast.

visual.verdict: Corvo braces and thrusts his left arm; a single wind streak sweeps out in front of him on the observer, then he returns to the armed stance.
From a distance the streak fans out ahead of Corvo and clears within about a second.

items.scope: Corvo casts Devouring Swarm (power variants 23 and 25): the partner presents the cast and recovery, and the swarm appears in the observer world, spreads across the floor and disperses.

visual.verdict: Corvo lunges and throws his left hand forward to summon the swarm, then recovers.
A dark mass of rats spreads over the floor ahead of Corvo for about a second and disperses.
